## PUBPRES-PLAYABILITY-FINAL-001 — Draft / HOLD

This is the isolated continuation of programme #717 and frozen Draft #757 (`c90dbc46e1f57f28e06b1f4205b83467335ff657`). Accepted main remains `00cdb02f103265b6dc5224c68283e9a0c8cb449f`. No merge, Ready promotion, production-default activation or release is authorized by this work.

### Current exact campaign

Head **`c2f8a73d34448bc1496ecd84bca02f0812c80d27`**, tree **`351b947a50ce054361660eba9379006122527547`** is running [qualification 45452580606](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/45452580606). Plan/adversarial source contracts and independent Linux/Windows native builds passed. All four runtime closures were independently verified against 105 committed native inputs each, exact build logs, compiler pins and dependency custody. Linux/Windows graphical comparisons and the extracted Windows evaluator are executing; full native/sanitizer qualification and the separately identified Godot 4.7 font-publication engine build remain active.

The candidate includes:
- Occupied-mask bounds and a separately reviewed derived-Empty Wave storage certificate. The latter skips only proven redundant gather/scatter and remains **unselected**: its local timing screen contains adverse small/no-body controls, substantial host drift and one insufficient-worker control. Full lifecycle, Wave, spill and body-boundary semantic checks pass.
- Default-off bounded material deadlines with one immutable cumulative pending packet, fixed admission deadlines, exact accepted-upload ACKs and owner/World/failure cancellation. The next actual GPU and off/30/60/60/30/off controls retain every physical gate.
- Calibrated submitted-pose/material freshness and whole-process CPU observations. Actual collider ownership, Rapier completion and Follow transforms are independently joined; deferred Separate draw notifications never borrow a live Main material identity.
- Sustained eight-actor live-paint/erase mixed qualification, original Safe regressions, small/medium/large confirmation and real completed-step comparisons.
- A source-exact stock-engine Windows evaluator with ordinary launchers, representative scenes, immutable manifests, native authoring, Save/reopen and bounded evidence collection.

### What the completed second campaign established

[Run 45436083078](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/actions/runs/45436083078), source `515fce2862dd87d8dd01935bdf7bd1736e645901`, remains **failed**.

Both platforms passed all twelve graphical correctness processes and completed source/slot captures. An added allocation checker incorrectly required an observed fixture extent for generated reference2048; the independently registered extent repair preserves the original failed run and all raw evidence. All sixteen captures on each platform pass complete preserved physical/GPU replay. The Windows replay also recovered and verified actual GUI/Rapier/native bytes; a separate peer check joined all sixteen results to original raw traces and independently calculated metrics. Its full replay SHA-256 is `74e9b7f7f8a7cb8bccf47c6f684b348f4d8888ebf0a0296adf2ecd1a95d204bf`. The original workflows remain failed, and all four Windows performance directions remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.

Linux current Wave2048 supports a relative occupied-bounds gain, but still has roughly 150–270 ms physical gaps. Windows does **not** reproduce that source gain: D/C/C/D rates were 3.604/3.716/3.734/3.861 real steps/s. Wave512 is unresolved.

Three-slot publication is a retained **negative** control. Windows Wave512 rates fell from 13.602/13.765 with two slots to 9.080/9.065 with three, while maximum gaps rose from 248.089/248.607 ms to 700.931/709.374 ms. Large Windows slot arms were also adverse; Linux supplied no strict slot win. Repeated slot timing is prospectively retired while every slot correctness, ownership, allocation and launcher gate is preserved. Full2 remains the ordinary default.

### Separate renderer and engine ownership

The original #609 EGL cache repair fixes the hosted GLAD initialization boundary. It does not qualify ordinary Separate Workbench: all four second-campaign ordinary Separate starts aborted on an empty CowData byte buffer, despite passing the smaller two-image oracle.

The new engine retains that EGL repair and snapshots mutable font-atlas Images at ten TextServer publication boundaries, after original alpha/mipmap processing. Exact source patches, dependency/compiler flags, public API/ABI and payload proofs are bound separately. Before any timing it must pass four font controls with exact framebuffer parity, actual ordinary Safe/Separate Wave512 startup, and both 180-revision two-image GPU history gates. Timing then compares Safe/Separate/Separate/Safe within the **same new executable**. Hosted ANGLE/Microsoft Basic Render Driver results do not establish physical NVIDIA behavior.

The second evaluator passed ten other launches plus actual native authoring and fresh-process Save/reopen, but its optional Separate failure prevented collector execution. That package is unqualified and retained. The new stock-only package has its own complete included-content gates; it does not reinterpret the failed old package.

### Evidence and acceptance

- [Canonical continuation](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/c2f8a73d34448bc1496ecd84bca02f0812c80d27/docs/operations/pubpres-playability-final-001.md)
- [Causal architecture and decision packet](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/c2f8a73d34448bc1496ecd84bca02f0812c80d27/docs/audits/2026-11-24-pubpres-playability-final/decision-packet.md)
- [Independent second-campaign decision](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/c2f8a73d34448bc1496ecd84bca02f0812c80d27/docs/audits/2026-11-24-pubpres-playability-final/development02-independent-decision.md)
- [Retained adverse/invalid native screen](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/c2f8a73d34448bc1496ecd84bca02f0812c80d27/docs/audits/2026-11-24-pubpres-playability-final/native-empty-derived-screen.json)
- [Windows owner acceptance matrix](https://github.com/techrote/cybersand/blob/c2f8a73d34448bc1496ecd84bca02f0812c80d27/tools/pubpres_final_windows/ACCEPTANCE.md)

Local integrated apparatus checks: 49 final-driver, 16 new-engine, 11 presentation/resource and 14 package tests passed, plus committed 99-file engine-owner driver custody. These do not replace hosted execution or user playability acceptance.

Final comparative selection, verified evaluator artifact identity and physical Windows 11/NVIDIA sustained interaction remain open. Fast uploads, render FPS and successful capture jobs are not the success criterion.
